in_arabic.name: Lujaina
in_arabic.long_meaning: Lujaina هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'L-J-N' which means 'to rest' or 'to be safe'. Lujaina is a name of grace and beauty in Islam. It is mentioned in the Quran as a name of one of the wives of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) (Quran 12:23).
